author: lance030315
content:
If anyone has the ability to go to the UC sometime between 10 AM and 3 PM tomorrow, the National Marrow Donor Program is going to be there. 

They’re looking to add people to the bone marrow donor database, which is used to find matches for those suffering from blood diseases and certain forms of cancer (such as Leukemia)

I joined their database tonight, and I recommend you stop by and do the same if possible. The procedure’s gotten much less invasive, can save a life, and all it takes to be added is a simple cheek swab.

The people running the drive can answer any questions you may have about it.

Yeah basically just looks out of order. Each new row is just when the entries were input. So if it goes like:
8/26/25
4/3/25

nothing got deleted, we just logged something from the aug26 before we logged the thing from apr3.
Integrating bot stuff to human language is hard so I’m trying to get it to understand the previous entries before adding new ones to avoid duplicate entries. This way we can manually add stuff still if needed, but it should also be able to log stuff directly from our email. But yes just a bit of trouble:
A) getting the bot to recognize $ values as $ and not transaction numbers as $
B) getting it to recognize when a payment its putting in matches a payment from before
C) getting it to match each income/expense to the proper category based on the context of the email. For example, 15 $2 incomes in a row is most likely a fundraiser of some sort
